question: Should Crabbox accept this full External desktop contract—including cross-platform persisted routing, operator-managed macOS passwordEnv credentials, and the bearer portal-viewer bootstrap—or require a narrower External macOS credential PR first?
rationale: The implementation adds broad user-facing configuration, routing, credential, and portal-auth surface; tests cannot determine which subset maintainers want as the permanent generic External-provider contract.

options.title: Narrow then prove
options.body: Split the bearer-viewer bootstrap, retain the provider-neutral External macOS credential path, and require exact-head live macOS proof before merge.

options.title: Accept full scope after proof
options.body: Keep the combined branch but require exact-head macOS proof, upgrade coverage, green checks, and explicit acceptance of the viewer-bootstrap security boundary.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave External desktop credentials out of core until a supported real endpoint and clearer product commitment are available.

recommendation.title: Narrow then prove
recommendation.body: Split the bearer-viewer bootstrap, retain the provider-neutral External macOS credential path, and require exact-head live macOS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the adjacent merged credential-boundary work and performed the branch's repeated integration, security, and scope reviews.
